exerciseInformation.title: Tricep Skull Crusher V2
exerciseInformation.description: The Tricep Skull Crusher (also known as the lying tricep extension) is a classic isolation exercise targeting the triceps brachii. Performed lying on a bench with dumbbells, it emphasizes elbow extension to build size and strength in all three heads of the triceps.

howToGuide.title: How To Perform Tricep Skull Crusher

steps.instruction: Lie flat on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Start with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended directly above your chest.
Grip the dumbbells with your palms facing each other. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your forehead. Keep the movement controlled, focusing on moving only your forearms.
Pause briefly when the dumbbells are near your forehead, then use your triceps to extend your elbows and return the dumbbells to the starting position.

setupGuide.title: Setup Guide
items: Select a pair of dumbbells with appropriate weight for controlled movement.
Position a flat bench in a clear area with adequate overhead space.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Bring the dumbbells up to a starting position with arms extended directly above your chest, palms facing each other.
Engage your core and keep your shoulders pressed into the bench throughout the exercise.
